candidates.hook: Cart driver lunges off the bench, striking the royal guard across the chest and tackling him.
candidates.cliffhanger: The guard lies unconscious and the road is clear, but the loyalists slip inside the cathedral—what will happen next?
candidates.why: Immediate violent action grabs attention and leaves the outcome of the infiltration unknown.

candidates.hook: Alexander lifts metal shears and snips his overgrown hair, shedding his disguise.
candidates.cliffhanger: Now fully groomed and in ducal attire, he steps into the snow toward the chapel—will he succeed in rescuing Juliana?
candidates.why: A striking visual transformation signals a hero’s return, creating intrigue.

candidates.hook: Alexander emerges in immaculate ducal regalia, his coat fluttering as he strides into the winter light.
candidates.cliffhanger: He commands the soldiers to secure the chapel, but the battle inside remains unseen.
candidates.why: Heroic entrance showcases his reclaimed status and sets up a high‑stakes confrontation.

moments.desc: Cart driver lunges, striking the royal guard and tackling him – sudden violent surprise.
Loyalist applies a sleeper hold; guard goes limp as the cathedral doors open for the infiltrators.
Alexander uses shears to cut his hair, shedding his disguise and revealing his true identity.
Alexander steps out in full ducal regalia, adjusting his lion‑crest cravat, ready to lead the assault.
